nom: Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot Serum with Glutathione

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin, whose other products usually trigger breakouts, reports no breakouts and a visibly lighter complexion after two weeks.
segments.dry: A reviewer whose skin gets quite dry in winter finds the serum moisturizing enough on its own, though she layers extra moisturizer on top by preference.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one oilier in warm weather and prone to cystic acne, report no breakouts and comfortable wear, though one saw only subtle changes after two weeks and was unsure about long-term results.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, rosacea-prone or eczema-prone skin mostly tolerate the serum well when introduced slowly and used less often, without irritation even near the eyes; one reviewer with rosacea reports it triggered a flare-up.
segments.normal: Several reviewers who describe their skin as normally tolerant and not prone to reactions, one saying it handles AHAs and Tretinoin without issue, report severe reactions to this serum instead, including facial swelling, burning, a chemical burn requiring medical attention, and a rash with pustules.
segments.mature: A 52-year-old reviewer with post-menopausal, mature skin reports the serum leaves her skin hydrated, smooth and glowing with no irritation.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on firmness and fine lines report softened fine lines, improved elasticity and a firmer feel around the eyes after consistent use, alongside brighter under-eye circles for one reviewer, with effects described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer's severe adverse reaction included extreme dryness alongside burning and swelling; otherwise the large majority describe the formula as hydrating rather than drying, including use directly on dry, flaky patches, and one notes the vitamin E content keeps it from drying out skin the way some vitamin C serums do.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers report no redness or irritation, including several using it near or under the eyes; however, a distinct cluster of reviewers, some explicitly stating they do not normally have sensitive skin, describe severe reactions -- facial swelling, burning, a chemical burn, or a rash with pustules, some requiring urgent medical care -- and one reviewer with rosacea reports a flare-up.
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers credit the niacinamide content with supporting the skin barrier alongside hydration; separately, the reviewers who had severe reactions describe extreme dryness, burning and swelling consistent with acute irritation rather than a barrier-supporting effect.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers using it for dark spots, sunspots, scars or post-acne marks report gradual fading over one to several weeks, describing the effect as noticeable but slow; a couple of reviewers report no noticeable brightening yet after about two weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who are acne-prone, including one with cystic acne, mostly report no new breakouts and some fading of blemish marks; one adverse-reaction review lists pustules as part of a broader reaction.

Absorbs quickly with no sticky or greasy residue
Very small tube empties quickly for the price
Color or packaging inconsistency between orders
A little product covers problem areas, stretches further than size suggests

extraits.texte: I had a very bad reaction to this product. After using Arencia Vitamin C Booster Shot, my entire face became swollen, painful, extremely dry, and felt like it was burning. I had to stop using it and seek medical advice. I wish the product listing had included a clearer warning that some people may experience strong irritation or allergic reactions. Everyone’s skin is different, but my experience was very unpleasant and caused significant discomfort. Please be careful and consider doing a patch test before applying it to your whole face.

BEWARE! Bought this when I saw that Becca Bloom uses it. It caused a very bad reaction around eyes when I used it on my face. I had to go to urgent care to get steroids to calm down the swelling and irritation. I almost NEVER get irritated from products and I’m used to using AHAs and Tretinoin on my skin but this product is another level somehow. I don’t recommend it for obvious reasons. Save your money!!

I heard great things about this serum and bought many tubes before trying it. However, I used it for 5 minutes and had a chemical burn on my face after application, and had to seek medical attention immediately after removing it. My dermatologist told me it was a severe chemical burn and to refrain from use. I was scared because I do not have sensitive skin. Do not recommend.

extraits.titre: Great brightening ingredients. Multiple forms of Vitamin C could irritate very sensitive skin.
extraits.texte: I am a big fan of Korean skincare, and Arencia is one of my favorite Korean brands. So I was excited to try this vitamin C booster shot serum. This formula contains multiple forms of vitamin C derivatives and niacinamide for brightening. It also contains a solid mix of ingredients for hydration and skin soothing. The tube is quite small, but only a little is needed to cover the face. While I really like this brand, and think this contains an impressive collection of ingredients, I have rosacea and very easily irritated skin and this product caused my rosacea to flare up. I think this reaction would be a risk for a very small portion of users. Though I personally do not feel safe using this with my compromised skin, this remains a great brand in my mind and I feel this is fairly priced at $13.

extraits.titre: Great serum, definitely recommend.Great serum, definitely recommend.
extraits.texte: I love this serum so far. I have been using this serum for 2 weeks now and I am noticing that my skin is becoming lighter. I want to mention that I have an oily and acne prone skin, a lot of facial care products give me breakouts, but this one has been great so far, and I plan to get another one after the current serum runs out. My favorite part is that this serum has a great rating in Yuka app, so it’s safe for your skin!

extraits.titre: Helpful for dark spots and sunspots. Goes on smoothly, not sticky or shiny.
extraits.texte: At 37, having spent a lot of time in the sun, I have quite a few sunspots and dark freckles. I started to use this after my PDRN and before my sunscreen and I do believe that it has helped with brightening the sunspots. It feels nice on my skin, it doesn't irritate it at all, and I haven't broken out while using it. My skin can be moderately sensitive. It doesn't feel greasy, but I do get a shiny forehead sometimes, and I'm not sure if it is because of this or just the weather getting warmer. All in all, I do think that it has been effective, but it is hard to measure how dark spots are. I do feel like they are certainly less noticeable though. The container is really cute, and the small size allows you to try and get used to it before deciding and committing. I don't notice a strong scent.

I’m 52 with post-menopausal, mature skin, and this Vitamin C serum is excellent. The texture is light and silky — not sticky at all — and it layers perfectly under moisturizer or sunscreen. My skin feels hydrated, smooth, and has a healthy glow after using it. I’ve tried several products from Arencia and they’ve all been impressive. This one gives my skin a fresh, bright look without any irritation, and the addition of glutathione and niacinamide makes it feel like a high-end formula. Absolutely love this — another beautiful, effective product from Arencia that really delivers.
